test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six colleagues - J, K, L, M, N and O - are sitting in two rows, 3 people in each row, which are in front of each other. There is equal distance between adjacent persons. Each person in a row faces another person from the other row. M is the immediate neighbour of L. J is sitting second to the left of L. N is not sitting at any end of the row. O, who is the immediate neighbour of N, is sitting diagonally opposite to J.

Who among the following is sitting in front of M?
solution:
Given: Six colleagues - J, K, L, M, N and O - are sitting in two rows, 3 people in each row, which are in front of each other. 

There is equal distance between adjacent persons. Each person in a row faces another person from the other row. 

1) N is not sitting at any end of the row. 

2) O, who is the immediate neighbour of N, is sitting diagonally opposite to J.

3) J is sitting second to the left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f306fc459f130b30b357115513ff143ed5087ae4535848a97fc4458b996123fd.png] 

1) M is the immediate neighbour of L.

And, K will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/674da1ed66993e8922585158a88b5b9de244c20e9df08b23a4dffb19a9ae64a2.png] 

So, '**N**' is **sitting in front** of **M**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
